ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the left vertical branch has two voltage sources connected in series; the upper source is labeled 120∠−90° V, with polarity upper end + and lower end −; the lower source is labeled 120∠−30° V, with polarity upper end − and lower end +. The node between the two sources is connected by a horizontal wire to the midpoint of two series impedances Z in the middle vertical branch, and the arrow of current I on the horizontal wire points to the right. The middle branch has one impedance Z at the upper and lower sides respectively, and the right branch also has one impedance, labeled Z=(80−j35) Ω. Reasoning: According to the specified method, take the source/center midpoint connected by the horizontal wire as the reference node, and let V_M=0. From the source polarities set V_T−V_M=120∠−90°, V_B−V_M=120∠−30°, so V_T=120∠−90°=−j120 V, V_B=120∠−30°=103.923−j60 V. Each middle impedance takes Z=80−j35 Ω. Current I flows rightward into the middle node and supplies the currents flowing out from this node through the upper and lower middle impedances: I=(V_M−V_T)/Z+(V_M−V_B)/Z=(-V_T−V_B)/Z=(j120−(103.923−j60))/(80−j35)=(-103.923+j180)/(80−j35). Complex division gives I≈−1.9166+j1.4115 A. Converted to polar coordinates: |I|≈2.38 A, ∠I≈143.63°.

method.method_draft: Let the source/center midpoint connected by the horizontal wire be the reference node, V_M = 0. From the source polarities, set V_T − V_M = 120∠−90° and V_B − V_M = 120∠−30°. Use Z = 80 − j35 Ω for each middle-branch impedance. The current I flowing rightward into the middle midpoint must supply the currents from that midpoint through the upper and lower middle impedances: I = (V_M − V_T)/Z + (V_M − V_B)/Z. Substitute the two phasor voltages and divide by Z, then convert the resulting complex current to polar form to obtain 2.38∠143.63° A.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧竖支路有两个串接电压源；上方电源标为 120∠−90° V，极性为上端 +、下端 −；下方电源标为 120∠−30° V，极性为上端 −、下端 +。两个电源之间的节点通过一条水平导线接到中间竖支路两只串联阻抗 Z 的中点，水平导线上电流 I 的箭头指向右方。中间支路上下各有一个阻抗 Z，右侧支路也有一个阻抗，并标注 Z=(80−j35) Ω。
推理：按指定方法，取水平导线连接的源/中心中点为参考节点，令 V_M=0。由电源极性设置 V_T−V_M=120∠−90°，V_B−V_M=120∠−30°，所以 V_T=120∠−90°=−j120 V，V_B=120∠−30°=103.923−j60 V。每个中间阻抗取 Z=80−j35 Ω。电流 I 向右流入中间节点，供应从该节点经上、下中间阻抗流出的电流：I=(V_M−V_T)/Z+(V_M−V_B)/Z=(-V_T−V_B)/Z=(j120−(103.923−j60))/(80−j35)=(-103.923+j180)/(80−j35)。复数除法得 I≈−1.9166+j1.4115 A。转换为极坐标：|I|≈2.38 A，∠I≈143.63°。
